##### Arhaus Celebrates 40 Years of Timeless Design with the Fall 2026 Collection and The Anniversary Issue


The Anniversary Issue celebrates four decades of Arhaus while the new Fall 2026 collection introduces a bold exploration of color and materiality alongside the brand’s new Made-to-Order Stone program


### The Anniversary Issue celebrates four decades of Arhaus while the new Fall 2026 Collection introduces a bold exploration of color and materiality alongside the brand’s new Made-to-Order Stone program


BOSTON HEIGHTS, Ohio, Aug. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --[Arhaus](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cRqt81yj7m9v1EXlqs_-uzTJr1ZKyowReLfpC5DJ4x7Kdk-pAGj6gv-tng8vpDyuzeUp-zJhSaIpnborvtAGdw==) (NASDAQ: ARHS), a leader in artisan-crafted and responsibly sourced home furnishings, today announced the launch of its[Fall 2026 Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=75lNhmp3JtXK2Ysp9mEbatCcedt7BHUeLZr2qHU_sp84Q5BL_KhRppoGE0r0-EAjikGCbq3aqwJ93oyKbq1V2K4g_Ujjxq51W7WFaL49P3VaGJlKXmJzaKVOUT8grtWj) , featured in The Anniversary Issue celebrating the brand’s 40th anniversary. The collection reflects four decades of artisan partnerships, global sourcing, and enduring craftsmanship while continuing to push the brand’s assortment forward. Richly figured woods, expressive natural stone, saturated upholstery, and unexpected applications of fabric come together in a season defined by a new confidence in color and materiality. New arrivals from the Fall 2026 Collection are available now at[Arhaus.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cRqt81yj7m9v1EXlqs_-uxZaPLOBOb-bKFq4JcUbMidngeMBNFR8yg0CtbIrJzpzNnLHRMNxOURoqFg137Tl8A==) and in more than 100 showrooms nationwide.


“Forty years ago, we opened our first showroom with a simple idea—to offer beautiful, thoughtfully made pieces that were different from anything else we were seeing,” said John Reed, Arhaus Co-Founder and CEO. “This collection reflects how far we’ve come while staying true to that original vision. It brings together incredible materials, artisan craftsmanship, and relationships we’ve built over decades. It’s the kind of assortment that could only come from forty years of knowing who we are and what we stand for.”


**LIVING IN FULL COLOR**
Inspired by nature, the[Fall 2026 Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=75lNhmp3JtXK2Ysp9mEbatCcedt7BHUeLZr2qHU_sp8uD3bk2Etk_9cybcvSnTt2cLPlG22QaYBWMg9gIOgtLO5y9-Q_J5tSy1IcuO2Kbt6iSpZ9buGscHEkZfNDKvgs) introduces one of Arhaus’ boldest color stories to date with a rich palette of[grounded greens](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bG-5v6MKDnT6gO1vw5m5-tMx9lO3J9bMM4poX3GlYoC7fRTHMNKAlbQZWZNJmtld3FDghVR7nA6sSeWYqgG-0DzsmpTLVSLVuMRakE9L3R3NpEHq7NvsTHEWuEwrMXZQm39mBkDiDpppt56GJuhTDA==)[,](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WMSISl3LLXQkH2c-l0t3xdvdZNu00DY_1tj_p_RiSG2U-B7U-iVqxvoHqZHOYLvYJpEzns6VqMaECxCN1JtBc8V2dkXpTxUPo4e-u-UAqaDKheuB1-0nyX24dOF31fVb)[storied reds,](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cv--c_ulWKDQ56oUZiNGWHDniEWp3GK0s4e1rX3d7DV3wFqT3uxgqFxKk0NvSFbpgmimELRpMNsKN3S3YFNLqM7DmYIQIIsy51BawLQICPI9lIlMzzX2oyypQvtP7091xcS2aNxpbjuwqXbfPckkMw==) and[heritage blues](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=dRpwN4x0sSRn41L1wOTRdMFgUQYpmhZMnCZ4j1rWDdLH5XNdOiiz5nAxDqOYMMU5VFwe3ljutK0BGsCWKgJpalqSb7vSXkIOQ4LoiNBC4NOndNQf0ZyDNYlKRO8WC1keJI3PS6kSfnJPP6uY2KruJA==) that treat color as a design statement rather than an accent. Green carries into other materials and forms, from the[Romy Pendant](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=W2ru9g_4haiEeTPJ2HKyg6ZgLhvMx20X33WLvOAlj--sZC91rKX8v1lsZatzNo4W4KCtbdAZVqWY1JZPrFE4_R0PhG7GcAnSmaAO8B5pmarPZmEGOgE6GqKoDs1iHYGo_iN9QY8hb6yq8S8OzuVfzg==) in green glass to the sculptural[Zyra Coffee Table](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=-u_TTV6oj7qilmHmwSfMkP_qIRhQpqIEG6mp_yLs8yGEsy-tQYz4MxXmjUJ1ud8Zz40mzzXnxgtfk8CXxGhPX7IkMyNksYS3SaQ6DLvTklKWvql0Fl-wShpRNbVGvZnR49evAYNCRb70wue1n-qVLY8nnKZsnGhLoVSpMijRt0Rh9xKny_cAEWMxaJfGbIVcp_aKT-wLp_hbfNOy50yYHGYFPTBRcJkQy7eaIUkwpuJoqPyOYyvsGAC2KX3TEN4HviPL3OrkCYYAIINw0CuSgFy7MXdcIXAPsa1IRw7X-YG5Iw5pyjy0nyh5sGDs_5Ywt619tVbQm9hDCbAs7_JCuX_r2Z8EW7A9IiDEUYvw-oJVQlHg8oJS6V1CzkQhxSj6XN57IHO-reg4NEEPODUMJCRpKXTSKd3225c27zxVy4A=) , crafted from natural green onyx. From there, the palette shifts to oxblood across both upholstery and casegoods, including the[Cortland Sofa](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=cGIPmP5S6GW3COOzhDqinL4vOoPU9zWl9fVqTH4geavX6qpP5tveCSJvNmeVkHw60qIgcpkPXrV5iaGT1rFQ6-k4nH5J1VYOPy3M-XHNOBZ3Q95ey4LthSauM0ubIurgi9doHsUFFn8STPe4RxyT4g==) and high-gloss lacquer[Bryer Media Console](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=IRICrbB4sWZxxfVylMCp0QxxhPi6iBO3Xi83XpOlF26-l_bTnkGlEyaeZEHgXBl1F1vRtPvly8pP97Dor8oIvpf_cV1qEGA6OzvFopgxJ8u3zxP1OzQMVTP8QvkWdXYzVcMOEzx8HVEVDMLgmT89m-1QOKPdMf_jqrRoqsewacc=) , while heritage blues emerge on the[Gatlin Glass Cabinet](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=pEM9yaNp3AUB0G6Y4Lal7f5TiO8ZytA3XaSYyT7C3-U8yd3Oh6Kiw6fpQyEJOOJtmRwHKOR1YPQ81tgNqD4mMaSPaVLXvS9EWApsybIid8PhXuSOOodmMZDWMm2eY_b0nUHK5_d4frbToI1X468uvfix0Ny54129e3SKc_19av4=) and[Henley Dresser](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Mo4QVAlDvyip-QVuC1xhQRJZFMxaFhHyR24W2nUWMfHGl-XaIb6QKOCZp_aSl1IegzrWE_pHipHYePkgv3V5dxTrk8wDkuWIKycHs3Kvph1ttmwZHKr0-yYnlEkFwG_Mq2DnbdOp1eq2pFEdGwfNIuer3wGbhIXHU-iywMacTy0=) , bringing another layer of expressive color to the collection.


**STATEMENT-MAKING STONE**
Expanding one of Arhaus’ signature materials, this fall marks the debut of the brand’s[Made-to-Order Stone program](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ET1eacCRreCjUh9k9dCKs7pDTJ2ovO0HvmXXAUzgXIOyv_LxjGYS1bUlqmb0gcVlUyPAyxf-nDVEy1LvJr0V4atQe4Zha7C6modTvZtD59sp1rggPcwtcV01YCo2BxIEFFtD07ZyducE4kTL5T60tA==) , offering clients a curated selection of 12 natural stones and marbles sourced from renowned quarries around the world. Available across[Saint Germain](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=_nYScgg7Nm8mtzeLR4ktSmuVwwRU4PgEMiLNZiiMRvgP8KN9XafAaCvEPjSEdePCCrJc7wBcVwqPibz7sz0VS-J9P4hCnd1nb6-P1ZB53l1Oh3OEIDqi2HRtnJxF43c4pdiSpYnFaidNvxm1MjC1VvrUoxBNpGUZRvfg6esCMhWLUZKXiNJCyJuQYBHekaowlmMuLwpGvqxx4xPjPMhW9beM4TxQ31Qn6r1ZJKnQ0lg=) ,[Danae](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=WKjsyhNDmXenv4UXm_LbbG1sGEKwZrOHPFGEbRd4wQiIO5dS3fZuAPfeuJDDHVyNFd_lEqPYmq73VJPEVuzsD1gNwZULmQXtdgITBiXkRlI=) , and[Ilaria](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=w3G17NhG--7YYMFNoKi-gSRB-06FsR5XPRa2BJOz3BJvOtfhpKq2H1ij0KS6_AP5djWaBV6lMYYwk_D5gNHeNcTgAVjDKcgm3-qQ6rlaADQ=) dining and occasional collections, as well as select[Vaso](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=nGHnJqnwvD7UvZsZ20-AJJ8tJKo4jT0QL8Bsqt0j3nFKJwzaAaQbhL4kTqgItz0LOAsKBoEsjy56HWTNDzqBozbnQG8k2_89VEQSbYoatekT2mmAounRHKohU7hQsGYnw266KhfSUJdqRAWRomo1Ng==) ,[Riven](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h9vu6PtZVTFGZpIbsvnPzalky07ktK8wrhmc5j_lnijNtKfYPqwuTIC3-f8Y5772qvbdtsIOiTvApUkSeDe6zM5XrkHaD0am9Qcht62_UBsICLwbSnVJBZnSxVeEWveEqqii8wLrHQ-3xJaGrvTIiA==) , and[Vertiz](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3A4ZUmYVw5-le_ya-0kGSAe24kdZJGP_OSlHzYfoGQhannohN1hFfN8XTADLc_sUATKp9UPp-3jUVXxydUApVtjxrg6wwzhsstBrjc_9ptpSzstLID91z0huqbYyqNwy1AJ-DBprE5npto0b2uHoMYjmD1jZjbYKTT-WltnQxcI=) bath designs, the program brings a new level of personalization to some of Arhaus’ most distinctive silhouettes. The assortment spans 10 marbles—including Carrara, Black Marquina, Calacatta Viola, Arabescato, Rosso Francia, and Raggio Verde—and two limestones, Bluestone and Grey Travertine.


**RADIANT & REMARKABLE WOOD**
The collection’s celebration of natural materiality continues through wood, where distinctive grain, depth, and inherent variation become defining elements of the design. The new[Palma Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Gx5bembofrIMCb1nh5b7lGQCzBfurQt2FW7hoxeUQ-bZoDsVjZ6BLRXweNrkzoYWw8L4N0WaoFjlw4-JtiTONm-xDz1eEUe48dePQH3IgLUXD2dkeoSpUr3pdeNvqgWUZIMMVCrwjtp7bhtYi_sL2PfRJUpaTCdnHHEg3cxoOTFtjJien9PSPdfik1IyVa_tbRTBr4Oy8bEgdqZfEi9oQUefxi4BYB2lvA0Uv0U3HHA=) pairs richly figured cerejeira and primavera veneers to create warmth and dimension across dining, bedroom, wall, and media console designs. The story continues with the[Frances Bedroom Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=eWRs2E57q85Pbwp9OT2aq6qB_dLFUM_oSk0OT-zB8J5jqBLPPsoBGLrWEJGGnxFc-YZrM4HG9PI_2M3Bvab5ngTCiogbRAcR3Qp_Fp_Ay0qotKKdqnjLbA6rroteCKPTl0XZs256RLKx4ZH0rR0wXNe8o6kkgRmhlAA7s0cspepNBKvp6YTddIbBqdG94FljB4hWLd0bTheVI8TU3HK-tc50Qx4xG3OIbpTK3g-21i0=) , crafted from mahogany and book-matched figured mahogany veneer, and the[Redding Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=zRSZULFJP93F7g33mwBScgCSGLpkEMoeS41ybOVgk-Gmdp-U8rUr0yKyD-718nWOMsre-8ZuZ1vQ67hSusHTQJ2LiVr68TPrkKCBsnJWeEhVO0U99tT0qWxql7S4kndJrFnB5SQP7bO_k8NwCFV7fw==) , where reclaimed oak veneer celebrates the knots, cracks, and natural variations that give each piece its distinctive character.


**THE COLLECTED HOME**
The season also expands upon[The Collected Home](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=tcJkdyIOqEADoAVv-n0WOtkFDJ_5_wox7QxckgzgDAjFSu-5xmkhu_m_1XXlDLZ7N9LlFV4329ZcATYbiY81tnXilrZJAEt7n2KEDB96KNkakDewbSPOD57kkfQKz4A9T9ET6Fa_bFKypNaKZdRy_tHy7kI0HiE4bCTjLvkzIPyhjgxQcd-tZ2gpx_CoyP1YOoeN6i5d1X6i5YbycdTZbWj6ovnXti7a69a_B36oa1k=) , Arhaus’ celebration of interiors that feel gathered over time rather than designed all at once. Rooted in enduring design and rich materiality, new introductions blend traditional forms and decorative details with a fresh, relaxed point of view. The[McKinley Sofa with Fringe](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=DH65t0uV2tipVOqGNZlWHDiVG5FTxPxsGpq3-9DqfVU8kJV22H2LwTwKIVmPHGi6lqtYv3fyIERkUbGF5ctmH_m7U5dck13DMbPnRojvBSogDSoXWG1uK3luDINoz3ConaBoegQ2qAjbhfQy5CIr0V9Y5uuoIpgGQuQOD3lRuHvPba4adY056l1uG_hwOokH) ,[Augustus Chair with Fringe](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=QXrRo3DTx55kHocHg9zf4gxPOj_-DC5D6e_hg0aglpfOR97BB4F_FON96AhzYl10D9r635PQKJTzAF6XvlPzvYPJ6jWLG6EZiG_fBqacWhYfLCSjd_EJJguC1t-QJmDy70b7UMVFgaTHJ7T5ngsr18VhsYx85jSUBmaJKfbMTrssqA0rTiOryqhqAyKCRe60) , and[Polly Chair](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=aah0FnXEOjOAo3dMc8ZZD72XRxHM4rUn5KXgBwlQSz4e1dEWUL4aqSEbmj3ibX8caiZLZ4hN3GM_KJ_eCPQf9rjWav6uje56SZRxA4v9y6krUlEuB6JaB7O7OtaWJzx4wr_je_Sh1cgX33VyL5u4-A==) bring rolled arms, tailored details, and decorative trim into the assortment, while the[Grant Media Console](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=X05Sh0T9b410mPe-pRld19tzfTpEcmdWfP4JsayX6JrWQds3SreUTRgtwU3IPj43KifrPORgSaReFuAnfPvncYmJ5N803y9j_cN9qSjgLAED1b8AUlYJSwyB-YOjdB5V-e7d_VtUBoWatNJVY3ceGxVQF5wi0vQ0qIjggwAlc-8=) , wrapped in Eden Flax InsideOut® Performance Fabric, and[Fresca Sideboard](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7bOKPGGFiRVOo0uvoPaCim9FEr_4lWFEjjZ96QYreLPEbogWzlF7Bw3uFhoLpY7MxBYs_ZKpZJVXqq6-O_YOzrRfSl59SdYOlBQ-_XWpWjFMlwYF0U7JhboQTNX3RNYlAbJBjO2O3wUD6ymfOVmAQiXOMbNoVs0l43_faY8Iz54=) , crafted in oak and wrapped in linen, introduce fabric to silhouettes traditionally defined by wood. Further expanding opportunities for personalization, the new Arhaus Trim Collection offers exclusive leathers, custom thread colors, and refined finishing details, while artisan hand-knotted rugs bring additional warmth, texture, and depth to layered interiors.


**ELEVATED ENTERTAINING**
Every memorable gathering begins with considered details. This fall, Arhaus expands its entertaining assortment with new bars, bar carts, tabletop, and serveware designed to make hosting feel as effortless as it is inviting. Leading the season is the[Coventry Bar Cabinet](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=mmhbKFtZH2DsOUmxy6MRVxUa3uHiCO2qt7wdQtW2crYEBvcX_ZKM_6VA-KgFtSzFMjGFzpgX8OsPyBt4rHgtDA0RwG1mT42J5kzjzLOG5mmY1n_wGzAA77OZhjXJN83p9XBC9rdeXuDvrSUWa_JKScqCA5taSASxg5FJ2PNKUnk=) , crafted from reeded white oak with a Carrara marble top and integrated LED lighting, alongside the new[Dayana Bar Collection](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=rMwqxqJwzvzgy6vQLA3jc3S3lSiqtmQvwqNu3B3hng2RQdKVhQx9dEMk4j_9cPzHLa3J3XGqxY1M2L2eZlcoHRpZ6_0M2cV55aGMwk1z-LSzaR6Z1ui707t5_ySbsyqD) and[Silas](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=sQZyMIOBjPwNS5jQXUA6kRyUT3ckhvlKCrQ_wVwmxnvGP_7ah1DIKFmWsr1thBAdstt7rRkJeNLrc7od1I4i78T2b0irIeG06pI2qAZVCCri28FHKKRrxxWUhKJVqr55ido2XzDHAxxSjjHP45dHiQ==) and[Poppy](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=jXMslOAeEI1Q71ZD9eaBWA_q0Yjuot3z-N1hZq4rePXiUlrWThSA-5Chm_LhwY2sqEZ8aoCYxt1_usie3gtsDGlOyZ1RdFBLLopLYc3we7g27GdOi4BX0CeYCmqInj_08hbzTLfI8czEhSQtp1qyZw==) Bar Carts. New tabletop introductions, including[Rhoswen](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=h0t2w4YqPvwfGwuecruzvtsgdhmVHorE3eIG_EDFV8UhxaepmX1otwkT12H2dO7w0S1ajQtQf0B_4B5a5U5xWnB50ZifenOOEmyXCiPjTJ4=) and[Saskia](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=vYS_QuL2C7K0s9hmoKAtkXT4YRxJ2JPskRDrcYuRbKedqFqH9YcCZM1GYaiE3WUvhRJ8JSELM5UWYNs6mNmsua1FL7ikltL829SOrwuUj34=) dinnerware,[Aurelian](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=PM3TSxq-S5yMbGAP3OnlEBeUAqyT1QHagsvIRWya52qg89aMdNO2IbpEtMPKtjrwmn_co9BdZpQsINpZLJnAnaT_vlQD8koq2Vy9zzWPt38=) serveware, and[Della Cocktail Glasses](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=qO-EV-JvFrwN_oOlUVefwDodVEGqprM2b__PfqKpKqivDJabCisSZcv_8BzVmuVWzLeRQuw3klZztnMCmbGAkpMFDcYau7pwxLNlJvHHJ-EkBvAeTBwg6r457UUZzcX5) , complete the story, offering thoughtfully designed pieces for every occasion.

**About Arhaus**
Founded in 1986 by Chief Executive Officer John Reed and his father, Arhaus is a premium home furnishings brand built on a simple idea: furniture and décor should be responsibly sourced, lovingly made, and built to last. Arhaus operates a vertically integrated model, designing and sourcing products directly from skilled artisans and carefully selected manufacturing partners around the world, including domestic upholstery production at its own North Carolina manufacturing facility. This approach enables Arhaus to offer a highly exclusive and customizable assortment of heirloom-quality furniture and décor designed to be used and enjoyed for generations.


With more than 100 showroom locations across the United States, Arhaus’ integrated omni-channel model connects every client touchpoint, from showroom and interior design to eCommerce and catalog, allowing Arhaus to meet clients wherever and however they choose to shop while delivering a highly personalized client-first experience from discovery through delivery.
